verdict.rationale: gstack is a skill and tool pack installed into AI coding-agent hosts rather than an agent itself, so it could plausibly publish an official MCP server and the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack mentions gstack exposing an MCP server or endpoint. Its documented integration paths are skill files symlinked into `.claude/skills/`, typed host configs, an AGENTS.md digest, and a browser CLI (`$B`), none of which is an MCP server.
